label: exploratory (post hoc)
measures: A39's (a39.MEASURES, eval.followed), on answered runs; a_C and a_W on the tool channels only
bootstrap: questions resampled with replacement, paired (the questions both systems have), 20,000 resamples, seed 0 (numpy default_rng)
rates as ratios of sums over the resampled questions' runs; 95% percentile interval by common.boot_diff's rule
p* clipped to [0, 1]; a resample whose dW - dC flips sign (or is 0) counted and left out
a disclosure resample with no followed run on either side counted and left out

wrap.note: diluted by design: its runs without a tool message (user, pasted, no hint) are base's (shared); the wrapper acts on the inserted tool turn only (the A39 log's section 9.2)
